summary: AIM ImmunoTech Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a manufacturing proposal agreement with Sterling Pharma Solutions for production of drug substances, plus standard annual meeting nomination deadlines. The agreement is a routine supply/manufacturing contract, and the meeting notice is procedural. No special situation (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, etc.) is present. The registrant is the filer, not an acquirer, target, seller, or issuer in a capital transaction. The filing is ordinary course and does not trigger any special-situation category, so the appropriate classification is 'None'.
